messages.content:
Why do I have to authenticate myself whenever I try to push my dotfiles, but not with any other directory (I already setup github ssh)

```sh
❯ git push
Username for 'https://github.com': dev-gaitano
Password for 'https://dev-gaitano@github.com':
remote: {"auth_status":"auth_error","body":"Invalid username or token. Password authentication is not supported for Git operations."}
fatal: Authentication failed for 'https://github.com/dev-gaitano/dotfiles.git/'

╭─░▒▓    ~/dotfiles  on   dev ⇡1 !8 ▓▒░                                                                                                                                                           ░▒▓ 128 ✘  took 7s   1  ▓▒░─╮
╰─                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     ─╯
```

It seems like the remote for your `dotfiles` repository is configured to use HTTPS instead of SSH. Git will use HTTPS authentication (username/password or token) when the remote URL starts with `https://`.

I'll check the remote configuration for your `dotfiles` repository.
